1. (Currently Amended) An assembly comprising a test tube with an affixed MTP, wherein the MTP is __light-activated__.

2. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in the test tube __such that the light-activated MTP is responsive to light activation for reading__.

3. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube, __oriented for reading downwards through the bottom of the test tube via light activation__.

4. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the test tube is a biorepository test tube __designed for long-term storage of biological samples and wherein the light-activated MTP is configured to remain functional after extended storage periods__.

5. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer __and wherein the light-activated MTP is protected from degradation by the polymer material__.

6. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the test tube __such that light activation can be performed through the bottom of the test tube__.

(Currently Amended) A system for storing samples and comprising the assembly of claim 1, and one or more of the following: a rack for biorepository test tubes; an automated robot for moving racks or biorepository test tubes __and reading the light-activated MTP__; and an automated sampling device adapted to sample said racks or biorepository test tubes __and configured to work in conjunction with the light-activated MTP reading capability__.

14. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 13 adapted for low temperature operation, such that the racks/test tubes are handled at -20°C or less __while maintaining the functionality of the light-activated MTP__.

15. (Currently Amended) A method of forming a test tube assembly of claim 1, comprising __heating a light-activated MTP to above the melting point of plastic and melting a portion of the plastic with the heated light-activated MTP to embed the light-activated MTP within the plastic__.

16. (Currently Amended) A method of reading an embedded light-activated MTP in a test tube assembly of claim 1, comprising: providing an embedded light-activated MTP; and __activating the light-activated MTP with light and reading the MTP response__.

17. (Original) The method of reading of claim 16, wherein the embedding material is frost coated.

18. (Original) The method of claim 16, wherein the reader comprises a vial receptacle and wherein vial receptacle and the embedded MTP are maintained at a temperature of -20°C or less.

19. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer __and wherein the light-activated MTP is protected from degradation by the polymer material__.

20. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 19, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the test tube __such that light activation can be performed through the bottom of the test tube__.

21. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 19, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube, __oriented for reading downwards through the bottom of the test tube via light activation__.
